ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (dark-gray/black) to 30% high-intensity (white/light-gray) distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are mapped primarily along the mid-to-outer leading edges of both lobes, tapering toward the center. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the continuous boundary. acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) from barnacle attachment points and active calcified clusters visible on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible presence of live barnacle colonies on the extreme lateral tips of the fluke, creating a highly irregular, crusty pixel texture distinct from the smooth skin surface.
